A respected instrumentation engineer became CEO two years ago, cut opex ~28%, refinanced the debt, and bet the company on one platform.
recent_developments: The company is 12-18 months from launching a CLEAN-SHEET analyzer platform; management claims ~40% throughput and cost-per-test advantage vs its current platform in internal validation. If real, first competitive product in a decade; if it slips, the balance sheet leaves little room for another attempt.

The consumables line attached to upcoming reference-lab contract renewals is growing.
Sell-side consensus is deeply skeptical: most models assume the new platform gains little share and value the equity primarily on the reference-lab annuity.
